# Note for France: what HR will see differently (draft, 5 Oct 2026)

For Tshenolo to send. Five lines, plain language.

---

1. We are tightening how the HR dashboard handles small groups, so that no figure can ever point back to one employee.
2. Where a band has only one or two people, it will be combined with the band next to it (for example "40% and above: 4 employees") instead of being shown as a locked box.
3. Medians and charts will only appear once at least five employees sit behind them; until then HR sees "not enough data yet".
4. Detailed reports (sessions, sites, departments, period comparisons) stay as reports Key Wellness publishes each period, which is how HR receives them today; they will not be available as live, repeatable queries.
5. The reason is our promise to employees that their employer only ever sees groups, never individuals, and with small teams a live figure that can be recalculated can break that promise.

---

Background for Tshenolo, not for sending:
- Line 4 is not a change on HR's screen. HR's Reports tab has only ever shown
  published reports. What closed on 5 Oct was direct API access that no HR
  screen used.
- Lines 2 and 3 are what HR will notice.
- Until Batch 1, the stop-gap hides the Debt Health, Retirement and
  distribution cards entirely whenever a band holds 1–2 people.
